name: @flutterpilot/mcp-server

tools.name: flutter_connect
tools.description: Connect to a running Flutter debug app. If no URI is provided, auto-discovers running Flutter apps and connects. If multiple apps are found, returns the list for you to pick one.

vmServiceUri.description: The Dart VM service WebSocket URI (e.g., ws://127.0.0.1:56789/ABCDEF=/ws). Optional — omit to auto-discover.

tools.name: flutter_disconnect
tools.description: Disconnect from the currently connected Flutter app.

tools.name: flutter_discover
tools.description: Discover running Flutter debug apps on this machine. Finds apps via process inspection and port scanning — no manual URI needed.

portRangeStart.description: Start of port range to scan (default: 49000)

portRangeEnd.description: End of port range to scan (default: 60000)

tools.name: flutter_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the running Flutter app. Returns a PNG image.

tools.name: flutter_widget_tree
tools.description: Get the widget tree of the running Flutter app as structured JSON. Useful for understanding the app structure.

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth of the tree to return (default: unlimited)

tools.name: flutter_semantics
tools.description: Get the semantics/accessibility tree of the Flutter app. This is a compact, AI-friendly representation that includes labels, actions, and positions of all accessible widgets. Requires flutter_pilot Dart package.

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth of the semantics tree (default: 20)

tools.name: flutter_interactive
tools.description: List all interactive widgets (buttons, text fields, etc.) in the Flutter app with their positions and labels. Requires flutter_pilot Dart package.

tools.name: flutter_tap
tools.description: Tap a widget in the Flutter app. Can tap by coordinates (x, y) or find by text/key/type. Requires flutter_pilot Dart package.

findBy.description: Find widget by this method instead of coordinates

value.description: The value to search for (used with findBy)

tools.name: flutter_enter_text
tools.description: Enter text into the currently focused text field in the Flutter app. Tap a text field first to focus it. Requires flutter_pilot Dart package.

tools.name: flutter_scroll
tools.description: Scroll at a specific position in the Flutter app. Positive dy scrolls down, negative scrolls up. Requires flutter_pilot Dart package.

tools.name: flutter_long_press
tools.description: Long press a widget in the Flutter app. Can target by coordinates or by finder. Requires flutter_pilot Dart package.

tools.name: flutter_hot_reload
tools.description: Trigger a hot reload of the Flutter app. Applies code changes without restarting state.

tools.name: flutter_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate a Dart expression in the context of the running Flutter app. Returns the result.

tools.name: flutter_get_navigation
tools.description: Get the navigation state of the Flutter app, including current route, route stack, and navigator info. Requires flutter_pilot Dart package.

tools.name: flutter_get_performance
tools.description: Get performance metrics of the Flutter app including memory usage (heap, external) and frame timing (build and raster times).

tools.name: flutter_get_logs
tools.description: Get recent log entries from the Flutter app (captured via dart:developer log events). Buffers up to 500 entries.

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to return (default: all buffered entries)

clear.description: Clear the log buffer after reading (default: false)

stderr: FlutterPilot MCP server running on stdio
